notes.title: How to Run Dreams of Another on Steam Deck
notes.notes: [p]You can run [i]Dreams of Another[/i] correctly on Steam Deck using the following steps:[/p][p][/p][p]1. Open Properties… from the Dreams of Another Settings menu.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/437d6e044ef587c1dbc06938c8f3d6b8390ae5e8.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/39dfa29d5bfe09efd245f812f86b135d43574960.png"][/img][/p][p]2. In the Compatibility section, check “Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool”, and select the latest Proton version “Proton 10.0-2 (Beta)”.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/2f0e404bdace35cff3fceaa04cd5e44be724d78a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Now Live - Limited Time
notes.notes: [p]We are thrilled to announce that Dreams of Another is featured in the Best Indie Games Fall Show case![/p][previewyoutube="BQ3rDpbvxIg;full"][/previewyoutube][p]At the meantime, we are releasing our limited-time demo![/p][p][/p][p]This demo is the same one we previously presented at BitSummit . While the content is short, it offers a first glimpse into the game's distinctive point-cloud visual style and tis atmospheric, dream-like world.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo will be available for 2 weeks only - don't miss your chance to try it out! We can't wait to hear your impressions and feedback![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/01b7ee561c9610516be48b2729fac0acbe24d38f.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dreams of Another and PixelJunk Eden2 will launch on October 10!
notes.notes: [h2][b][i]Dreams of Another [/i]and [i]PixelJunk Eden 2 [/i]launching October 10th![/b][/h2][p]Latest PixelJunk title, [i]Dreams of Another[/i] (PS5/PS VR2/Steam), will be released on [b]Friday October 10th 2025![/b][/p][p]In addition, [i]PixelJunk Eden 2[/i] (PS4/PS5/Steam), will be released on the same day. Both titles were directed by multimedia artist Baiyon. [/p][p]A special bundle including both titles will be available at launch.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="wPSWbIoNL9o;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/c6c4b8bcf9f549733b4d6f3d378456596ddf0c93.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/268449916b767ae1956987733ae962655eaebb29.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/27a57f98e154ba53a4a2e2929d4f03ac85c15b08.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45543106/eeeb9a93bb9805c5578bb2dca58926e2abd7f9d6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3561230/Dreams_of_Another/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456570/PixelJunk_Eden_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p] We hope you’re as excited as we are![/p][p]Q-Games[/p]
